selection: first calendar weekday on or after January 2 of each year 2020 through 2026; no coverage substitution
sample_kind: bounded annual engineering/research sample, not full-archive census
membership: all 50 catalog branches and 8 extra units; process/ledger units retain their actual unit instead of 7 fictitious trading records
action_scope: documented clocks within 00:00–16:00 ET, plus previous-evening TBR other-session formation/action 20:00–23:00; conditional branch windows explicit in coverage manifest
all_year_capability: arbitrary ISO date range emitted as resumable per-date jobs including coverage dispositions; no outcome-dependent job replacement

evaluation_exposure.reason: Existing v1 outcomes, source cases and data investigations have been read. Dates/assumptions frozen before new v2 outcomes; this is engineering verification and descriptive research, not an untouched holdout.

integration_scope: input and boundary verification; these dates are not added to the opportunity denominator unless also in evaluation_dates; no claim of full-session measurement beyond acquired endpoints
comparisons: observable operational research variants, explicit assumption IDs; actual author trades/orders/fills remain separate
